doc.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023

title: Graz studies and liberating herself from the academic approach
summary: She studied in Graz 1991-95 then moved to New York, and later had to free herself from the desire to play it right.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Was part of that the jazz theory — at that point was this like the late 80s?
No, I went to college in ’91 — that’s ’91 to ’95 I studied in Graz in Austria and then I went to New York after that.

Well you’re a teacher yourself so you know that you can’t just teach a student and say well just play by ear because that’s where the soul is really going to come from. So jazz has been codified a great deal by now and I can see how when that starts to overwhelm something has to go and the feelings you were talking about I guess did and then it came back?

Yes. It came back but it was — I had to sort of liberate myself from the academic approach and from the desire to do it right — which of course it’s great to have those skills and to learn all of that, but there came a point when I wanted to reconnect with music on a deeper level again, instead of doing it the right way or proper you know.
